links.comparator_used: Naive chatbot baseline (free-form generation without the constrained framework)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate in pharmaceutical authenticity verification
links.effect: Hallucination rate fell from fifteen percent in the naive chatbot baseline to under two percent in MedTruth (50 pharmaceutical samples). The strict JSON schema was part of a bundled framework, so its effect is not isolated.
links.tradeoff: Mean verification latency stayed near 2.1 seconds.
links.quote: Testing across fifty pharmaceutical samples shows hallucination rate falling from fifteen percent in a naive chatbot baseline to under two percent in MedTruth while mean verification latency stays near 2.1 seconds.
